explanation: At most one current loan means the maximum participation is one, so the cardinality is one. Because a copy may have no loan at the moment, participation is optional, which is modality optional.
prompt: In a library model, each book copy can be on loan to at most one member at a time, and a copy may also be sitting on the shelf with no current loan. Which pair of terms best describes the participation of a copy in the loan relationship?
